name: Claritex
description: Claritex is a precision-targeted dopaminergic modulator that selectively suppresses the brain's default mode network while amplifying prefrontal executive function. The result is a state of sustained, almost architectural focus — distractions cease to register not because they are suppressed, but because the brain simply stops assigning them salience. One of Lazarus's flagship corporate wellness products.
effects: Reduced emotional noise during high-stakes work
Mild euphoria from task completion (dopamine reward loop amplification)
side_effects: Social blunting — difficulty reading interpersonal cues while active
Rebound brain fog lasting 2-4 hours post-dose
Tunnel vision on chosen task — inability to context-switch if priorities change
cultural_context: Claritex is the corporate world's open secret. Tier 3 analysts and Tier 4 executives alike keep a blister pack in their desk drawer. Lazarus markets it with clean white packaging and language about 'cognitive wellness' — the language of self-optimization, not addiction. On the Gray Zone, knockoff versions called Glass circulate, made in unlicensed labs with inconsistent dosing. the Gray Zone version has a reputation for occasionally locking users into obsessive loops — grinding the same task for 12 hours without recognizing it has become meaningless.
story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive's Claritex prescription is being quietly monitored by Lazarus — the company has added an undocumented telemetry compound that logs what users focus on while dosed, building behavioral profiles sold to third parties.

A the Gray Zone-side Glass cook has figured out how to strip the rebound crash from the formula, making a version that doesn't wear off — users are disappearing into sustained focus states, found days later dehydrated and locked onto unfinished projects.

A Tier 2 student took their sibling's Claritex before a licensing exam and focused so completely on the wrong section of the material that they failed — now they're trying to get the prescription legitimized before the retake.
